case_number: 2024 INSC 835; Civil Appeal No. 1012 of 2002 with multiple connected cases
summary: Constitutional challenge to Article 31C validity; interpretation of Article 39(b); distribution of material resources; safe harbour from Articles 14/19; historical context of Directive Principles; reconsideration of Sanjeev Coke's precedent; determination of 'community element' and 'materiality'; invalidation of prior interpretations as inconsistent with textual analysis.
final_judgment: Constitution Bench reference resolved; prior precedents on Article 39(b) interpretation overruled; Article 31C scope clarified; correct constitutional interpretation established.
